svg.aria-label: Intrusion press: a target system drops into the hopper on the intake console (left); the scanning drum sweeps it for vulnerabilities and the intel drum (Google GTIG zero-day counts) each feed the press down a cable, and the exploit die stamps an exploit onto the card in the exploit cell. The exposure dial reads the zero-day rate — 8/mo in 2025, 11/mo in 2026, 22 in Aug 2026 — the audit-log drum keeps the paper trail, and the outfeed chute (exploit + report) stays gated behind the lit orange STOP lever, which is in the STOP position: nothing ships without human approval. Verified numbers (Nov 25, 2026): Nov 24, 2026 breach — CIA + ODNI + NGA, ARTEX harness, 0 classified touched, 8 days after the GTIG warning.
svg.text: NOV 24, 2026 · CIA + ODNI + NGA · ARTEX · 0 CLASSIFIED TOUCHED · 8 DAYS AFTER GTIG WARNING
